purpose: Teach: 射程/救世主/宮廷/攻防/急落/惹き/激動/無念

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界、本気で、当社の射程に、絶対、いる、攻め続けろ、社員、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対、頑張れ、本気で、絶対、本当に、本気。
lines.en: I need this industry in our sights. Keep pushing. I'm counting on every one of you. This matters.
lines.style: Clipped, measured authority. Each phrase lands with weight. A slight pause between thoughts—not hesitation, but deliberate emphasis. Leans forward slightly on 'counting on.' Unmistakable: this is non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様にとって、本気で、当社が、絶対、救世主のような存在に、なりたい、社長、本気で、頑張ってまいります、本当に、絶対、本気。
lines.en: Yes, sir. We want to be the company that saves our customers. We will give everything to that mission.
lines.style: Formal but earnest, no performance. Steady breath. Speaks to the mission itself, not just the boss. A quiet intensity underneath the politeness—this is personal commitment, not just obedience.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業者は、宮廷文化への憧れ、強かった、と、お母さんから、聞いている、本気で、絶対、深いお話、本当に、絶対、本気で、感謝。
lines.en: The founder had a deep admiration for court culture. Your mother told me that. It's taught me something I'm grateful for.
lines.style: Slower pace, reflective. Gentle on the personal reference—acknowledging the weight of history without overdoing it. A small pause after 'that,' letting the meaning settle. Not sentimental, but genuinely moved.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場の攻防、本気で、当社、絶対、勝ち抜いていきます、社員、皆、本気で、頑張ります、絶対、本気で、本当に、頑張ります、絶対。
lines.en: Yes, sir. We will fight and win in this market. Every person on this team will see it through.
lines.style: Firmer than before. The word 'fight' carries intention—not aggressive, but clear and determined. Eye contact steady. Speaking as someone who believes what he's saying, not reciting.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 株価、本気で、急落しないよう、絶対、社員、皆、業務、頑張れ、絶対、頼んだぞ、本気で、本当に、これは、絶対だ、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: The stock price cannot fall on my watch. I need every department to perform. Non-negotiable.
lines.style: Sharp, almost clipped. The opening word lands hard. Slight drop in warmth—this is business reality, spoken plainly. A pause before 'non-negotiable.' Not a threat; a fact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様の心、本気で、絶対、惹きつける製品、開発してまいります、絶対、社員、皆、頑張ります、本当に、本気で、絶対、本気。
lines.en: Yes, sir. We'll develop products that win customers' hearts. Everyone here will rise to it.
lines.style: Confident but not cocky. Speaks to the vision—'win their hearts'—with genuine belief. Steady pace. The closing feels like a promise made to himself as much as to the boss.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界、本気で、激動の時代、当社、絶対、リーダーシップ、見せていけ、絶対、本気で、頼んだぞ、本当に、これは、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: This industry is in upheaval. We have to lead. I'm asking you to be the ones who show how it's done.
lines.style: Sharp opening on 'upheaval.' Slight quickening of pace mid-sentence. The closing question implied but felt—are you with me? Direct eye contact. Authority tempered with something almost like appeal.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、創業以来、無念な、敗北、本気で、絶対、避けてまいります、絶対、お父さんの代から、引き継いで、本気で、本当に、絶対、頑張ります。
lines.en: Yes, sir. Since our founding, we've never accepted defeat. I carry forward what my father built. We will not fail.
lines.style: Slower, more grounded. The weight of inheritance in his voice—not burden, but responsibility he owns. Deliberate on 'we will not fail.' The final statement sits with quiet conviction. An ending that closes a door.
